function.name: sort_array
function.description: Sorts an array of integers in ascending order. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

array.description: The array of integers to be sorted.

reverse.description: Determines if the array should be sorted in descending order. Defaults to false indicating ascending order.
